name: Amazon Business World Elite Mastercard®

welcome_offer.description: $100 or greater Amazon gift card or statement credit (amount and any spend requirement per the offer shown at application).
notes: Official U.S. Bank page (2026-10-19) states only "$100 or greater"; exact amount varies by offer.

earning_rates.category: Amazon.com, Amazon Business, AWS and Whole Foods Market
earning_rates.notes: 3% back on the first $150,000 in net purchases at Amazon-covered sites per calendar year (all cardmembers), then 1%.

earning_rates.category: Prepaid travel through U.S. Bank Travel Center
earning_rates.notes: 3% back on prepaid travel booked in the U.S. Bank Travel Center.
2% back on your top 3 eligible categories each billing cycle outside Amazon-owned brands, on the first $150,000 per calendar year, then 1%.
1% back on all other eligible purchases.

sources.notes: Official U.S. Bank Amazon Business cards page (2026-10-19): $0 annual fee, no foreign transaction fees, 5%/3% Amazon + Travel Center, 2% top 3 categories, 1% other, $150,000 annual caps, "$100 or greater" welcome offer; issuer U.S. Bank National Association.
Official Amex notice: replaces the American Express Amazon Business American Express Card on August 14, 2026.

notes: U.S. Bank successor (2026-08-14) to the Amazon Business American Express Card.
